大显存20(不会降低速度)
小显存40
自己看着来
Large memory 20 (speed will not be reduced)
Small memory 40

最下面那个一定要有
The one at the very bottom must be there.

You can use either context options, or the original long gen method.

When using context options, set num_frames and frame_window_size to be equal'

Otherwise set frame_window_size to something the model is capbable of doing normally, original default is 77, 81 seems to work too.

Original method is probably better for motion etc, and is faster, but the benefit of context windows is that it doesn't degrade over time on long clips.

如果觉得预览好,可以去操作区,把随机种变成上次运行的,打开放大和插帧

If you think the preview is good, you can go to the operation area, change the random seed to the one from the last run, and turn on magnification and frame interpolation.

step

如果3步觉得不够可以调成4步,但是会有点过头

If 3 steps are not enough, you can adjust it to 4 steps, but it will be a bit excessive.

帧数
frame rate

长视频自动循环一组为77.哪怕最后一组只有一张也会跑77

Long videos automatically loop in groups of 77. Even if the last group has only one image, it will still run 77 times.

如果你觉得背景不怎么动,可以加上运镜参考,上传相同人物的视频还可以提高一致性

If you feel that the background doesn't move much, you can add camera movement references. Uploading videos of the same person can also improve consistency.

放大保存和插帧保存,预览结果好就使用上次的随机种然后打开他们,当然你也可以不关直接放在这抽卡

Enlarge and save, and insert frames and save. If the preview result is good, use the previous random seed and open them. Of course, you can also keep them open here for card drawing without closing them.

当你想用原图原背景原人物,而非视频背景,就关闭它

When you want to use the original image, original background, and original characters instead of the video background, just turn it off.
